scope: Local C11 processor-systems workstation, CPU and platform diagnostics, embedded helpers, bounded memory/transaction modules, measurement tools and Win32 GUI; not a federated network compute service.

status_policy.rule: Use implemented or partial only when repository code and focused verification paths support the exact statement. Record limits explicitly. A design document, capability catalog or profile-validation job does not prove runtime behavior.

controls.title: Module boundaries and versioned contracts
controls.assessment: The C modules and architecture-atlas layer expose explicit local component boundaries with dedicated tests.
limitations: The current contracts do not establish a stable network ABI or a general multi-process service platform.

controls.title: Input validation and idempotent state changes
controls.assessment: The APSIA and transactional-runtime paths validate bounded inputs and reject stale snapshot generations in their documented scope.
limitations: The transaction engine changes caller-owned in-memory snapshots; it does not perform hardware flashing or persistent database commits.

controls.title: Low-level I/O and transport boundaries
controls.assessment: Interop and trace modules cover selected local host/API boundaries with focused regression tests.
limitations: This is not a network transport or distributed RPC implementation; outbound network access is not part of the stated product boundary.

controls.title: Concurrency, scheduling and backpressure
controls.assessment: The repository has local pipelines and embedded components, but a verified bounded worker scheduler, queue backpressure and concurrent cancellation contract have not been established.
limitations: No load, race, saturation or worker-shutdown tests currently prove general concurrency behavior.

controls.title: Memory ownership and resource lifetime
controls.assessment: A dedicated memory/arena subsystem and regression test exist for selected local allocation and resource paths.
limitations: The test does not establish a process-wide memory ceiling or safety of every caller and native boundary.

controls.title: Data integrity and transactions
controls.assessment: The C11 transaction engine provides bounded staging, CRC checks, optimistic generation validation and rollback for in-memory snapshots.
limitations: The word flash in this API means committing an in-memory snapshot; it is not a physical firmware or device operation.

controls.title: Failure handling, recovery and lifecycle
controls.assessment: Transaction rollback and guarded error states have focused tests; recovery remains limited to the local snapshot contract.
limitations: No persistent storage recovery, distributed failover or physical hardware recovery is claimed.

controls.title: Security, privileges and secret handling
controls.assessment: The repository documents default-deny, bounded-work and explicit-approval policies, with validator tests for the declarative resilience profile.
limitations: Policy/profile validation is not a kernel sandbox or proof of privilege enforcement in every native module.

controls.title: Observability and diagnostics
controls.assessment: The trace subsystem records diagnostic events with a dedicated native test and measurement-provenance documentation.
limitations: Local trace output is not distributed tracing or a hosted metrics/alerting service.

controls.title: Performance budgets and capacity
controls.assessment: CPU benchmark statistics are collected and tested as local measurement data; service-capacity and horizontal-scaling baselines are not defined.
limitations: Benchmark aggregation does not itself demonstrate that a workload meets a performance target or scales under concurrency.

controls.title: Configuration, extensibility and integration
controls.assessment: The interop and embedded-C surfaces provide controlled integration points with native tests and documented boundaries.
limitations: External modules do not acquire unrestricted host or hardware authority through these interfaces.

controls.title: Verification and delivery gate
controls.assessment: This PR adds a machine-readable backend engineering profile, safe-path/status validator, negative self-tests and a dedicated CI gate.
limitations: The gate validates profile integrity and evidence paths; it does not certify hardware safety, OS-level control or production readiness.
